lines.t: I try to carry what was never mine
To measure up and trace every line
I let the fear whisper in the dark
Forgetting the love that holds my heart
My weary hands are dropping away
I hear your voice calling past the gate
You paid the dowry, you bore the stain
You took my weakness and took my pain
Now I stop reaching for what I can't earn
And let your devotion burn
I choose you, my love, my sacred peace
In your mercy all my struggles cease
You are the way, the truth, the life
I owe a love more precious than purest gold
Not in my strength, but in your grace
I run into your warm embrace
You saw my heart when I lost my breath
Stretched out your hands and conquered death
You call me beloved, you call me yours Beyond the storm, behind open doors
It's not the burden of what I must do It's simply choosing to walk with you
I choose you, my love, my sacred peace
In your mercy all my struggles cease
You are the way, the truth, the life I hold
A love more precious than pure is gold
Not in my strength, but in your grace
I run into your warm embrace
When weakness comes, your strength appears
Your endless love casts out my fears
Here's my reasonable service, my simple song
Is a knowing to whom my heart belongs
I choose you
The only way, the only life
Forever yours, your joyful bride
I do
